new_pages.text: How can I get access to a developer account given that I am already a Front customer with an existing user acount? | Community Skip to main content New post Login Home Discussions Developers Developer Q&A How can I get access to a developer account given that I am already a Front customer with an existing user acount? Front Developer Fronteer 3 years ago Dec 9, 2022 12:54 AM UTC Please advise where I can find the developer environment within my front connection. developer account Like Reply Follow Share Javier - Developer Relations Answer Community Manager 3 years ago Dec 9, 2022 12:57 AM UTC You can create a free developer account on our Developer Portal . If you’re an admin in your existing Front instance, you can certainly access the settings that would allow you to perform developer actions like creating apps that use our APIs or plugin or channel features within your existing account. However, we generally recommend you create a separate (and free) developer account so that you can test your integrations in an environment that does not contain your production data. Once you are satisfied with your app, you can port it to your non-developer, production instance by creating an app in that instance and updating your integration to use the production credentials. Cheers --Javier Javier - Front Developer Relations View in thread Javier - Developer Relations Answer Community Manager 3 years ago Dec 9, 2022 12:57 AM UTC You can create a free developer account on our Developer Portal .
